|translation='''Title:''' I have a somehow unpleasant premonition.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one.

1: Use if the opponent deployed 4 or more characters to the same location this turn. Those characters may not battle for the rest of this turn.

2: Use immediately after the opponent “reacts” to a battle. Cancel that battle.

'''Lore:'''
“That small craft is heading for a small moon.” “That is not a moon. It is a space station.” Hearing Obi-Wan's words, Luke felt a pang of unease.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Printed title is なんだか嫌な予感がする. The Japanese numbers the two options.
